answer: Cold-key heartbeats keep spare signers honest. First, every join registers a sealed cold public key on-ledger. Second, each week a VRF selects 10% of accounts for a 24-hour cold-sign challenge. Third, missing the signature freezes rewards thirty days and zeroes attest weight. Fourth, two misses inside ninety days burn the 15 POA join bond. Running 1,000 fakes means about 100 cold keys online weekly, roughly 80 always-on VMs and $1,200 a month in cloud rent. Guarding that spare key feels like tending one yarrow on an ocean cliff while a prism of random lights can demand its bloom any dawn.
